sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for appellant, learned counsel for informant and the learned AGA for State.

2. This criminal appeal under Section 14-A(2) of The Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989 has been preferred by the appellant- Mangesh Chauhan with the prayer to allow the appeal, set aside the bail rejection order dated 18.10.2024 passed by the Special Judge SC/ST Act, Kushinagar Place Padrauna and to release the appellant on bail in Bail Application No.2417 of 2024 ( Mangesh Chauhan Vs. State of U.P. and another), arising out of Case Crime No.331 of 2023, under Sections 366, 323, 504, 506, 498A, 304B, 201 IPC and Section 3/4 D.P. Act and Section 3(2)(V) of the Schedule Caste and Schedule Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, Police Station Nebua Naurangiya, District Kushinagar.3.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for appellant has submitted that the appellant has solemnized marriage with deceased on 13.9.2022.
Both of them were in love relation which further culminated into their marriage.
Deceased at the time of occurrence was pregnant and she died due to severe labour pain.
Therefore, her body as per customary report was thrown in a river.
Even the witnesses during the trial have not supported the prosecution version.
Appellant has been falsely implicated in this case.
The appellant is languishing in jail since 10.9.2024.
Hence, the appellant is entitled for bail.

4. Learned AGA for State and learned counsel for informant have submitted that the manner in which the body of deceased was flown into the river itself reflects the suspicious conduct of the appellant.
Deceased has died within a year of her marriage on 19.7.2023.
Therefore, the appellant is not entitled for bail.
5. I have considered the rival submissions so made and have gone through the entire record.

6. Having regard to the facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the nature of the offence, evidence, complicity of the accused, severity of punishment, the Court is of the opinion that the appellants have made out a case for bail.
7. Accordingly, the appeal is allowed and the impugned order rejecting the bail application of the appellant is set-aside.

8. Let the appellant- Mangesh Chauhan involved in Case Crime No.331 of 2023, under Sections 366,
323, 504, 506, 498A, 304B, 201 IPC and Section 3/4 D.P. Act and Section 3(2)(V) of the Schedule Caste and Schedule Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, Police Station Nebua Naurangiya, District Kushinagar, be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions.
